name: Simple Photo Gallery
original_description:
Create photo galleries and albums, organize your pictures, and share a photo story from ChatGPT. Simple Photo Gallery gives you a visual workspace with photo previews, gallery sections and your connected Simple Photo Gallery library. Work with photos uploaded to this service; it does not connect directly to Apple Photos, Google Photos or your phone’s camera roll.

What you can do:

• Make a travel album, family gallery, wedding collection, event recap or photography portfolio.
• Start a new private draft, or open and improve an existing gallery.
• Upload photos and videos from chat attachments, or reuse pictures already in your library.
• Arrange photos into sections by day, place, subject or the story you want to tell.
• Rearrange pictures, move them between sections, write captions and choose a cover photo.
• Review duplicate candidates and hide pictures from a gallery while keeping the originals.
• Ask for an organization proposal and review it in the visual editor before applying changes.
• Browse filenames, captions and available photo metadata; use visual inspection and optional AI analysis for curation.
• Publish an online gallery or share a private link when you ask, using the access settings you choose.

Try “Create a gallery from these vacation photos,” “Organize my trip into days and places,” or “Help me choose the best photos for a family album.”

Requires a Simple Photo Gallery account. Edits are saved as drafts; publishing and access changes are separate actions. Uploads, storage and optional AI analysis follow your account’s available features and allowances.
